name: Blueprint
tagline: Every line is a measurement; the signals are the title block.
mood: Quiet drafting-table confidence: thin blue ink lines on the terminal's own paper, every line ending on a tick and carrying the number it measures, nothing decorative that is not also a line you can read along.
rationale: A blueprint is glanced at, not read: the eye runs along a dimension line to the number set inside it, and the title block always sits in the same place. That is the glance pattern of a progress pane, so in this theme every line is a measurement. The header is one sheet-wide dimension line with 7/18 set at its centre and the done span drawn heavy. Every section line starts at a crosshair datum `┼` and carries its own measurement at the far tick: `? 1  ~ 1` for NEEDS YOU, the phase chips for PLAN. The four signals sit in a title block, the only thing on the sheet with corners. Labels are plain bold caps at the left tick, never letter-spaced: the character is in the line, not the lettering. The spacing complaint gets a stated grid instead of taste. Column 2 holds only ink (ticks, crosshairs, the title block's edge), glyphs hang on column 3 and words start on column 5 under every label. Nested rows step in by 2, the 13-cell right column ends on column 71 in every row, and exactly one blank row separates sections, so nothing blends into its neighbour.
tokenMap: bg: not painted; it is the terminal's own background (the hex is the preview page's paper, and the paper behind the desktop Svg). fg: theme key `text` (the hex is its rendition on the two papers). dim: `dimColor` on Text for metadata (sha, age, model, branch, the ELAPSED caption, done-step titles, the band's `╎` separators) and `inactive` for todo/folded tab labels. accent: ONE shipped hex, #2D86BC, the ink. The engine exposes no theme name (types/index.d.ts has no theme field), so a dark/light pair cannot run, and this single mid-value ink is chosen to clear 3:1 on every paper it may meet: measured 3.48:1 on the dark paper #0F2D4F, 3.54:1 on the light paper #F4F1E8, 4.00:1 on white, 5.25:1 on black. It carries only lines: the ├ ┤ extent ticks, the ┼ datum crosshairs, every `─` of a dimension line (including the meter's still-to-do span, which is simply the dimension line not yet drawn heavy) and the title block's ┌ ┬ ┐ │ └ ┴ ┘. No word ever sits on it. Every label is on a theme key, `text` + bold in plain caps: NEEDS YOU, PLAN, GATE, GIT, CTX, COST and the active footer tab `├OVERVIEW┤`; inactive tabs are `dimColor`. accent2: `text` + bold in the engine for the measured numbers (7/18 inside the dimension line, 2/6, 3h12m); the hex is how that renders in the preview. bg2: the hover background of pressable rows, drawn with the theme key `subtle` because a hex cannot follow light/dark; the hex is its preview rendition. success/warning/error: theme keys only, never hex, so done/doing/decision/blocker keep their meaning on every terminal; the meter's heavy done span is `success`. One other hex ships, on desktop only: the header meter's Svg cannot take theme keys, so its heavy span is #2F9A55, measured like the ink (3.89:1 dark paper, 3.17:1 light paper, 3.57:1 white, 5.87:1 black). The palettes are unchanged from the reviewed version: the blue ink is this theme's own, and the move away from the other ruled-page themes is in the line grammar, not the colour.

otherTabs: Plan: every phase is its own section line `┼─ ▶ B  UI ──────── 2/6 ─┤` (a Button that folds; the measurement is the phase count). Open phases list their steps on the same grid (glyph col 5, id col 7, 13-cell right column ending on col 71); folded phases are just their line. Log: one `┼─ LOG ──── 3 ─┤` line, then rows with a 5-cell time column on col 5 as `text` numbers and Rulings in warning. Step details: the step's title row, then `┼─ DETAILS ──── B3 ─┤` and an 8-cell plain-caps label column on col 5 (STATUS, NOTE, COMMIT, GATE, AGENTS, DRIFT) like a drawing's spec list, right column aligned the same way. Needs you: each question is its own line, with its id as the label and what it blocks as the measurement (`┼─ ? D1 ──── blocks B4 ─┤`); why/asked sit underneath on col 5, options are `[ per seat ]` buttons (recommended = primary) and the answer field comes last. Drift and answered items follow under `┼─ NOTICED ──── ~ 1 ─┤` and `┼─ ANSWERED ──── 0 ─┤`. Every label in every tab is plain bold caps in `text`; only the lines are ink, and only the Overview's title block has corners.
glyphs: Two line marks carry the whole sheet: ├ ┤ are extent ticks (where a measured span starts and ends) and ┼ is a datum (where something is measured from). Section mark: `┼` in ink on col 2, the origin of every section line `┼─ LABEL ──── measurement ─┤`. Header meter: one sheet-wide dimension line `├━━━━┼──── 7/18 ────┤`, with `━` heavy in success for the done span, `─` in ink for the rest, `┼` in ink at the tip (the datum where done meets to-do) and the number in `text` bold, centred and never overdrawn. 0 done draws no datum (`├──── 0/18 ────┤`); finished draws no datum and the measurement reads `✓ 18/18` inside an all-━ line. Band meter: `├━━━━┼─────┤`, the ticks outside 10 inner cells and the datum on the first undone cell. Steps: todo ○ (dim) · doing ● (success, bold, row bold) · done ✓ (success, row dim) · blocked ! (error, bold) · skipped – (dim, title dim). Current phase ▶ (success, bold); the phase chips ✓A ▶B ○C are PLAN's measurement. Decision ? (warning, bold, id in warning) · blocker ! (error, bold) · drift ~ (warning, bold, age dim). The NEEDS YOU line's measurement is the band's own pins `? 1  ~ 1` (warning glyphs, `! n` in error when a blocker exists), so the section signals at section level without a mark of its own; with only drift it reads NOTICED and measures `~ 1`; with nothing asked and nothing noticed the line and its rows are absent and the one-blank-row rhythm closes over the gap (header line, blank, PLAN). Gate not run yet: the GATE cell reads `○ not run` in dim; no commit yet: the GIT cell reads `○ none` in dim. Health: ▶ working / ! needs you / ✗ gate red / ✓ finished (bold, theme tones as today). Band separators: `╎` (U+254E) in dimColor, 3 cells with its spaces. Title block: ┌ ┬ ┐ │ └ ┴ ┘ in ink, the only corners anywhere on the sheet, with the labels set into the top border. Footer: the active tab is `├OVERVIEW┤` (a span between ticks) in `text` bold after the engine's `1: ` hotkey prefix, the others dim. No letter-spacing anywhere and no dashed or dotted runs. All glyphs width-1 BMP.
spacingRules: Sheet: 1-cell gutter (the pane's paddingX), 70 content cells, cols 2-71. Three fixed columns: col 2 holds only ink (the meter's ├, every section ┼, the title block's ┌ │ └); col 3 holds the hanging glyphs (health, level-0 row glyphs ? ~ ▶); col 5 is where words start (the title, every section label, since `┼─ ` is exactly 3 cells, every level-0 id, the title-block labels and values). Nested steps step in by 2: glyph on col 5 (under the phase letter), id on col 7. Ids: two spaces after the id. A 2-char id (D1, B1) puts the text on col 9 at level 0 and col 11 nested; the 1-char phase id puts it on col 8 (`▶ B  UI`); a drift item's age (3m) takes the id slot. Right column: 13 cells, right-aligned, last character on col 71 in every row (`ELAPSED 3h12m`, sha, `opus 6m Edit`, `blocks B4`, 2/6); titles truncate with … before they come within 2 cells of it. Section lines run col 2-71 as `┼─ LABEL ` + ink run + ` measurement ` + `─┤`, so the label starts on col 5, the measurement ends on col 68 and the ┤ sits on col 71. The run absorbs label and measurement lengths, so every line ends on the same tick; when space is short the measurement clips before the run drops below 4 cells, and the label never clips. Header: two rows. The title row has health on col 3, title on col 5, the branch two cells after it in dim and the right column; under it is its dimension line, col 2-71, with the number centred. That line is the only one not preceded by a blank row, because it belongs to the title. The branch drops before the title truncates. Rhythm: exactly one blank row between header and NEEDS YOU, NEEDS YOU and PLAN, PLAN and the title block; none inside a section; the footer sits directly under the title block's bottom border (the border is its gap). Title block: 3 rows, cells 22/25/8/10 of the 70, each label set 2 cells into its cell (`─ GATE `), each value under its label (2-cell inset), one value row. Breakpoints by content width: the header line and section lines scale to any width and labels never change form. The title block is proportional from 52 (each cell at least label + 5); below 52 it becomes a `┼─ SIGNALS ─┤` line over two plain rows (gate · git / ctx · $). Inside a cell `· 52s` truncates first, then `· 6 today`, never the sha or the state. Footer: col 3, 2-cell gaps (the existing gap={2}), the engine's `n: ` hotkey prefixes; 67 cells at 72. Never adjacent: a section line and the row above it (a blank row sits between), two right-column values in one row, a glyph and col 2 (col 2 is ink only, so a glyph always has a clear cell before it).
desktopNotes: Proportional fonts cannot hold a 70-cell line, so a section line becomes a flex row. The `┼` stays as a one-glyph Text in the ink, then the label (`text` bold, plain caps), a flexGrow spacer where the run was, and the measurement (`? 1  ~ 1`, the phase chips) at the right edge; marginTop 1 replaces the blank row. One glyph does not wrap, so the crosshair section mark survives on every surface and only the run between is dropped. The header dimension line is a row of two static Svgs with the number between them as a `text` bold Text. Each Svg draws its half of the line: tick end, heavy span in #2F9A55, ink rest, and the ┼ datum in whichever half holds the tip. For f = done/total the left half is filled min(2f, 1) and the right max(2f − 1, 0) of its width, so the number stays centred and the fill passes behind it as in mono. The title block becomes a Box with borderStyle single in the ink hex holding four columns (label `text` bold caps above, value below) with gap 2, wrapping to a 2×2 on the phone; the ┬/┴ dividers are not drawn, and it is still the only bordered thing on the sheet. Right columns use the flexGrow spacer as today (no space padding). Band: desktop only, same segments, dim `╎` separators kept. Mobile: as desktop, with Select/Input replaced by option Buttons and Reply in chat as today. Nothing animates off the terminal.

animation.idea: The datum walks: when a step is marked done, the ┼ on the header's dimension line steps right one cell per frame, the heavy ━ span growing behind it, until it reaches its new place. The number re-sets (7/18 → 8/18) on the last frame and the sheet is still again. The crosshair is the same mark that starts every section line, so the one moving thing on the sheet is the theme's own glyph. Nothing else moves.
animation.trigger: A step going to done (the done count rising). On the last step the datum walks into the ┤ tick and is absorbed, and the measurement re-sets as `✓ 18/18`. A gate passing or a question raised changes the title block or the NEEDS YOU measurement with no motion.
animation.cadence: 6 fps, one cell per frame, about inner/total cells per step (3 to 4 at 72 columns, so under 1 s), then no timer at all; skipped while the person is typing (the line snaps to its final frame). Terminal only: desktop, mobile and VS Code draw the static frame and never animate.
animation.staticFrame: ├━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┼──── 7/18 ───────────────────────────────┤, the header's dimension line exactly as overview line 2 shows it, with the datum resting at the tip; the band's 10-cell meter never animates.

feasibility: Section lines, the header dimension line and the title block are string-built Text in the monospace terminal (as `rule()` already is). ┼ ├ ┤ ╎ are box-drawing glyphs with the same East-Asian-ambiguous width as today's ─ and ━, so there is no new width risk. The title block's ┬/┴ junctions cannot come from Box borders, so on desktop/mobile it is a plain bordered Box with four columns, no dividers. The pane header's count is plain Text today (drawPane's h2 row), not a Button, so it can live inside the header line and inside its Client. The band's `7/18` stays its own segment because drawBand uses that segment's text as the band-plan Button label, so the band meter never takes the number. The paper is the terminal's own: types/index.d.ts exposes no theme name, so a painted hex background could not follow light/dark. The single ink #2D86BC clears 3:1 on dark, light, white and black papers (3.48 / 3.54 / 4.00 / 5.25) and carries only lines, now including the meter's undone span. The desktop Svg's heavy span is one hex, #2F9A55, measured the same way (3.89 / 3.17 / 3.57 / 5.87). accent2 and bg2 are `text` bold and the `subtle` hover background, not shipped hex. The band's dim `╎` separators are 3 cells with their spaces, exactly the old ` · `, so the drop loop, its room arithmetic and band60's kept set (health, count, step, gate) are unchanged. The meter's ticks and datum ride inside the bar/bar2 segments (12 cells, as before) and drop with them. The right pins stay `? 1  ~ 1` so the Button regex is untouched. `├OVERVIEW┤` is the Button's label; `1: ` is the engine's hotkey prefix as the README shows it. Plain caps need no width breakpoints, so the letter-spacing fallbacks are gone; the only remaining breakpoint is the title block (proportional from 52, a SIGNALS line below). B5's `sonnet 1m` is a behaviour change (today stepRow shows an agent only on a doing step) and is listed as such in implementationNotes. The Client meter is terminal only; desktop, mobile and VS Code draw the static frame.
implementationNotes:
- `meter(done, total, cells)` returns `{ filled, tip, empty }`, where `tip` is `┼` when 0 < done < total (drawn on the first undone cell, so `empty` is one shorter) and '' otherwise. `bandSegments` wraps it in ink `├`/`┤` inside the bar/bar2 segments (same drop level) and swaps ` · ` for ` ╎ ` on the same dim Text, so widths are unchanged.
- New `dimLine(columns, done, total)` for the pane header. inner = columns − 2; the number ` d/t ` is centred at floor((inner − len) / 2); round(d/t × inner) heavy cells are success Text and the rest `─` in INK. The number's cells are skipped (the fill resumes after it), and the tip moves to the nearer side of the number when it would fall inside it. Finished means no tip and the measurement `✓ d/t`. It returns runs so mono and the Client share one geometry. It replaces drawPane's h2 row. h1 gains a 1-cell indent so health sits on col 3 and the title on col 5 (today the glyph is on col 2); the branch moves into h1 after the title (dim, dropped first when room runs out), and elapsed becomes `ELAPSED` (dim) + value (bold) in the right column.
- `rule()` becomes `sectionLine(label, measure, columns)`. Mono builds `┼─ LABEL ` + INK run + ` measure ` + `─┤` to exactly the content width (run = width − label − measure − 8, the 8 being `┼─ ` + the three single spaces around label and measure + `─┤`; measure clipped before run < 4), with the label as `<Text bold>` and the measure as tone-coloured Text runs. Non-mono renders `<Text color={INK}>┼</Text> <Text bold>{label}</Text><Box flexGrow={1} />{measure}` with marginTop 1. NEEDS YOU passes the pins (`? n  ~ n`), PLAN the chips, the narrow SIGNALS line nothing. Sections are joined by one empty row (`<Box height={1} />`), never by nothing.
- `signalsBlock` becomes `titleBlock()`: three string rows from fixed cell widths (22/25/8/10 of 70, proportional from 52), with GATE/GIT/CTX/COST as bold `text` set 2 cells into the INK top border and the values at the same 2-cell inset. Below 52 it is today's two rows under `sectionLine('SIGNALS')`. Non-mono renders a `borderStyle="single"` Box (borderColor INK) with four label/value columns.
- `stepRow` / `needsBlock`: level-0 glyph 1 cell after the gutter (col 3, col 2 left to the ink) with the id on col 5, nested steps +2. The id is padded to 2 cells only when it has 2 chars; the right column is padStart(13) in mono and a flexGrow spacer elsewhere. Behaviour change: `right` also shows a running agent on a todo step (`sonnet 1m`, dim).
- Footer labels uppercase; the active tab's label is `├LABEL┤` in bold `text`, inactive labels `dimColor`; keep gap={2}, hotkeys and `role="dismiss"`.
- `const INK = '#2D86BC'` (one value; no theme lookup exists) and `const INK_GREEN = '#2F9A55'` (desktop Svg only). In mono only, the header dimension line is a `Client` surface (`datum-client`) that stores the shown tip cell. It runs `every(160, step)` moving the tip one cell per tick while shown < target, re-sets the number on the last tick, and snaps to target when the prompt is busy; non-mono draws the two static Svgs.
- Tests: `dimLine` returns exactly `columns` cells for 0, 1, 7, 9, 17 and 18 of 18 and never puts ┼ inside the number; `sectionLine` ends on the content width for every label and clips the measure before the label; the agent on a todo step appears for todo and still not for done; the band at 100 and 60 keeps today's drop order with the 12-cell meter.
